name: Kho ca loc chien mam me
nameVi: Khô cá lóc chiên mắm me
summary: Dried snakehead fried and finished with mắm me, a tamarind fish sauce that is sour and hot. Eat it with rice.
origin: Đồng Tháp Mười, in the old Long An half of Tây Ninh. Dried snakehead from kênh 79 is the base of the plate.
taste: Sour and hot from the mắm me, over the fried dried fish.
where: The drying yards along kênh 79 and the markets that sell khô cá lóc, plus orchard and countryside tourism stops.
seoTitle: Kho ca loc chien mam me in Tay Ninh
seoDescription: Fried dried snakehead with sour, hot tamarind fish sauce.
